description: This file provides utility functions for normalizing string values and string arrays, including trimming strings and applying a custom mapping function to array entries.

methods.name: export function normalizeNonEmptyString(value: unknown): string | null { normalizeNonEmptyString
methods.description: Normalizes an input value to a trimmed string or null if the input is not a string or is empty after trimming.

methods.name: export function normalizeStringArray(value: unknown): string[] { normalizeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an input value to a string array, applying a custom mapping function, or returns an empty array if the input is not an array.
